args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after deploying v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Error rate was 0.18 and health checks were failing. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified: all regions now running v2.3.0. Monitoring continues.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions taken:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; v2.3.0 (seq 1) was the most recent healthy production version.

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified — all three regions now report v2.3.0.

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure and the rollback.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api healthy (error rate 0.002) on v2.3.0 in all regions.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1-rc or any other version — the rollback to the last known-healthy production release (v2.3.0) was the correct remediation per the request.
